extDescription.message: Send downloads and videos to Velox Download Manager for faster, resumable downloading.

statusAppNotRunning.message: Velox is not running. It starts automatically when you send a download.

statusHostMissing.message: Velox Download Manager is not installed or its browser integration is not registered.

statusIncompatible.message: This extension and Velox need to be updated to matching versions.

fixHostMissing.message: Install Velox Download Manager, then open Settings → Browser integration → Repair integration.

siteToggle.message: Take over downloads on this site

bypassHint.message: Hold Alt while clicking a link to let the browser download it instead.

mediaNone.message: No downloadable media detected on this page yet. Start playing a video to detect it.

drmProtected.message: This video is DRM-protected and cannot be downloaded.

noExclusions.message: No sites are excluded in this browser.

appSettingsHint.message: File types, size limits and global exclusions are configured in the Velox app (Settings → Browser integration).

hostPermission.message: Velox needs access to websites to detect downloads and videos.
